Psalms 29 · Psalm 29: The Voice of the Most High
2M.6 We are to give to God the glory and praise due to his name (the LORD's name is to be praised).
22F.4 God will bless His people with peace.

points: Give unto the Most High glory and strength, and worship Him in the beauty of holiness.

note.label: Psalm 29: The Voice of the Most High

points: The voice of the Most High is upon the waters, powerful and full of majesty; it breaks the cedars, divides the flames of fire, and shakes the wilderness.

note.label: Psalm 29: The Voice of the Most High

points: The Most High sits King forever. The verse to hold is the last: He will give strength unto His people and bless His people with peace.

That time of strength and peace comes as long as we follow the directions seen in Psalms 27 and 28, making the Most High our refuge and trusting in Him; that is the only way to receive strength as His people and the blessing of peace.
